newsitem.title: USA: Leasing Solutions files for note offering.
newsitem.headline: Leasing Solutions files for note offering.

text.p: Leasing Solutions Inc. filed on Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of $50 million of convertible subordinated notes due 2003.
The company said proceeds from the sale will be used principally to fund its equity investment in equipment it leases to its customers and for general corporate purposes.
Underwriters Prudential Securities Inc. and Smith Barney Inc. have a 30-day over-allotment option to buy an additional $7.5 million of the notes, it said.
